title: SRI psi research
summary: Jesse Michels tells of SRI psi research, about late 1960s-early 1970s at Stanford Research Institute, Menlo Park, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: then you have SRI you know know in the late 60s early 70s

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions SRI, the Stanford Research Institute, a research lab in Menlo Park, California. He points to its work in the late 1960s and early 1970s on psi, meaning abilities of the mind such as sensing things far away or ahead of time. He raises it as a sign that serious institutions once looked into such powers.
